candidate.title: The `ip-allocation-timeout` flag (which provided a time limit on blocking CIDR identity allocations) has been removed
candidate.text: The `ip-allocation-timeout` flag (which provided a time limit on blocking CIDR identity allocations) has been removed. CIDR identity allocation now always happens asynchronously, therefore making this timeout obsolete.

evidence.excerpt:
* The `ip-allocation-timeout` flag (which provided a time limit on blocking
  CIDR identity allocations) has been removed. CIDR identity allocation
  now always happens asynchronously, therefore making this timeout obsolete.
